nbb.review:
Nbb mam onek tricky question kore..
Poray valo but Grade uthanu tough onek ta..
valo na amar kotha sunen jara valo bole tader kache sobai valo

she’s strict about attendance and general mannerisms in the class, doesn’t reschedule mids and quiz dates but she’s a really good teacher, a very humble person, she gives very easy and straight forward questions for all of the exams and it’s kind of easy to get a good grade from her.

it’s been a long time since I did this course with her, so I don’t have the materials with me anymore.
Class mannerisms like being on time, not using phone in the class (she absolutely hates this), try not to talk to others during lectures, keep your bag on the floor (she does not like it when someone keeps their bag on the table), ALWAYS WAIT FOR ma’am TO LEAVE THE CLASS BEFORE YOU EXIT, wait for her to gather her stuff and leave after she leaves the class.
These are some general rules and I don’t think it’s unreasonable to expect these from the students.

Nbb maam is good if you stay nice to her. Course itself is easy. Unar pattern mene porle onk valo korba. Quiz e time ektu kom dey and slides line to line porte hobe. Mid, final onk easy kore. Try to response in class as much as you can and be regular.

Ma'am is a sweet person in general but can be very furious if you don't follow her rules . You would get deserving grade, questions mostly come from her suggestions and there will be extra 2 marks for 100% attendance.

sbi.review:
SBI sir quiz e MCQ ,f/b, T/F diben . Mid final er jonno suggestion diben. Okhan thekei ques ashbe . Er baire kichu ashbena.
HML sir er quiz easy. Mcq easy koren 5/6 ta mcq thakbe and 4/5 marks er definition or structure diben . Sir class e poranor shomoy imp shob kichu bole diben. Question structure. Mid final Exam er age kono sug ba kichu diben na .

SMDA is very strict but besh bhalo poran. tar rules follow korte hobe, distract kora jabena, sound kora jabena. daily study kore ashte hobe, he asks questions individually. bhalo kore study korle you'll get an A.
I've heard Pyn is also very strict. no idea about her grades tho.
SBI sir is the coolest faculty you'll ever get. Goated. Main points gulo mention korlei hobe. He wants very specific answers.
ABE onek suggestions diye dey. slide bhalo kore porlei hobe. also class eo uni onek information share koren example diye. Try to note down those.

Sbi best
Slides theke sob ashe quiz e bishesh kre jegula bold kra oigula thekei sir diben..
Mid final e 2 marks question ashe bt oigula broad question so joto compact kre to the point likha jy totoi vlo.
Attendance 70% thklei full marks
